svg.title: Figure 11 · Walk-forward selection and stitched evaluation
svg.desc: Candidates 21, 42, 63, 126 and 252 sessions; up to 504 past sessions for selection; common eligible training start; 10 bps cost. First fit occurs after close 504 and first influences return 506. Positions and cash continue across evaluation blocks.
